t: What does the word pyong mean? - Quora
s: Answer (1 of 5): Pyong means flat in Korean. It’s also how big apartments are - it’s a measurement. There are many towns / cities in Korea that have it in their names, so presumably they were flat areas as opposed to mountainous since Korea is quite mountainous.
